messages:
elaine-partners: short sync: marketplace + SI co-sell for the rack bundle. we need a tight handoff flow, account mapping, and an HW reservation policy. target: launch prep next week.
matt-sales: okay — i'll run a sweep of Q pipeline and flag anything in eval/demo stages.
devin-si: request: SI claims only accepted if there's a POI tag or a demo booked (no cold grabs). we can validate demos in our intake form.
jen-comm: also request no public customer mentions until comms signs off. we'll need a checklist for quotes/case studies.
nick-hw: inventory note: limited dev racks. can reserve kits for claimed POCs for 10 business days after claim accepted. need a qty estimate with each claim.
matt-sales: how do we record claims? suggest a tiny CSV: `acct_id,acct_name,current_owner,region,stage,si_claim,claim_ts,claim_basis,qty_requested`.
elaine-partners: agree. add `poi_score` 1-5 so we prioritize fulfillment. place CSV in /shared/si_flow/claims.csv.
devin-si: SLA: SI must respond to claim questions and schedule demo within 48h, otherwise ownership reverts to AE. we'll tag missed responses as `si_unresponsive`.
ann-bot: calendar created: "SI marketplace intake triage" Mon 9:00am PT — attendees elaine-partners, matt-sales, devin-si, jen-comm.
jen-comm: comms owner will approve any customer-facing language. also require a 1-paragraph integration summary from SI before we publish listing assets.
elaine-partners: conflict resolution proposal: (1) AE with active forecast, (2) SI with signed SOW or POI>=4, (3) marketplace-origin leads. escalate ties to @jen-comm.
matt-sales: noted. action items: i'll run the sweep and upload claims by EOD; nick will publish SKU/qty; devin will prepare demo intake form.
elaine-partners: thanks team — i'll consolidate ROE doc and tag legal if needed. :rocket:
